title: 第175章 这下颌线，这小伙子懂摄影的
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

视频一开始，就是颜晨宴那个黑底金字的大招牌，紧接着是精致的骨瓷餐具。随后画面一切，林雪，张莉和赵可儿三人化着精致的妆容，在镜头前笑容甜美地打着招呼。

大飞极具煽动性的嗓音在背景里响起，“家人们，吃的就是一个氛围！看这装修，看这颜值！打卡出片绝对一流！”

视频发出去不到半小时，评论区底下全是嗷嗷叫的网友。

“卧槽，这店在哪？看着好高级！”

“老板娘有点东西。”

“这环境，吃口屎我也认了。”

天玺小区正门，颜晨宴店内。

打烊后，林雪三人没有急着走，而是围在收银台前，看着大飞刚发的这条视频。

看着屏幕上不断跳动的播放量和点赞数，林雪兴奋得直接跳了起来。

“我就说这钱花得值吧！”

林雪指着评论区，激动得满脸通红，“你看看，全在问地址！大飞这流量太猛了！”

张莉拿着补妆镜，美滋滋地看着镜头里的自己，“那也不看看是谁出镜。大飞还挺上道的，把我拍得比滤镜里还白。”

林雪说道，“明天让那两个员工早点滚过来解冻！包子，虾饺，拌面，各给我准备五百份！”

张莉捂着嘴笑了起来，“五百份？你也不怕把那俩人手给累断了。”

“一月拿四千块钱的工资，不累断手对得起我吗？”赵可儿满不在乎地拨弄了一下指甲。

次日。下午两点。

天玺小区侧门。范理早餐店。

范理准时拉开了卷闸门。

阳光有些刺眼，门外早就排了一群熟面孔。

“哟，各位挺早啊。”

范理和众人打着招呼，“进吧进吧，今天外面热，别中暑了。”

许峰直接霸占了靠空调风口的绝佳位置。

“老范，一碗爆辣牛肉面，一笼灌汤包。”

身后跟着进来的张强说道，“老范，给我来份清汤面，多撒点葱花。下午还要开会，吃辣了容易出汗。”

店里瞬间热闹起来。

“哎，老范，那两个视频你刷到没有？”刘业忽然抬头，朝厨房喊了一句。

范理手里正拿着漏勺捞面条，闻言疑惑道，“什么视频？”

刘业乐不可支道，“大飞啊！就是那个粉丝挺多的探店博主，我今天中午刚刷到。”

许峰凑过来说道，“他发啥了？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At the beginning of the video, there is Yan Chenyan’s big sign with gold characters on a black background, followed closely by the exquisite bone china tableware.Then everything on the screen showed Lin Xue, Zhang Li and Zhao Keer wearing exquisite makeup, smiling sweetly and saying hello in front of the camera.

Da Fei's provocative voice sounded in the background, "Family, what you eat is an atmosphere! Look at the decoration, look at the appearance! The check-in and production are absolutely top-notch!"

Less than half an hour after the video was posted, the comment area was full of netizens screaming.

"Damn it, where is this store? It looks so high-end!"

"The boss lady has something."

"In this environment, I accept eating shit."

The main entrance of Tianxi Community is inside Yanchen Banquet Shop.

After closing, Lin Xue and the others did not leave in a hurry, but gathered around the cashier and watched the video that Da Fei had just posted.

Seeing the number of views and likes jumping on the screen, Lin Xue jumped up with excitement.

"I'd say it's money well spent!"

Lin Xue pointed to the comment area, her face flushed with excitement, "Look, they are all asking for addresses! Da Fei's traffic is so intense!"

Zhang Li held the make-up mirror and looked at herself in the camera happily, "It doesn't matter who is in the photo. Da Fei is quite good, and he made me look whiter than in the filter."

Lin Xue said, "Let the two employees come over early tomorrow to defrost it! Prepare five hundred portions of steamed buns, shrimp dumplings, and noodles for me each!"

Zhang Li covered her mouth and laughed, "Five hundred copies? You're not afraid of breaking those two people's hands from exhaustion."

"With a salary of four thousand yuan a month, can you afford me if you don't break your hands?" Zhao Ke'er fiddled with her nails nonchalantly.

The next day.2 p.m.

The side entrance of Tianxi Community.Fanli breakfast shop.

Fan Li opened the rolling shutter on time.

The sun was a bit dazzling, and a group of familiar faces had already been lined up outside the door.

"Hey, it's early everyone."

Fan Li greeted everyone, "Come in, come in, it's hot outside today, don't get heatstroke."

Xu Feng directly occupied the perfect position near the air-conditioning vent.

"Lao Fan, a bowl of spicy beef noodles and a basket of soup dumplings."

Zhang Qiang, who came in behind him, said, "Lao Fan, give me some clear soup noodles, sprinkle with more chopped green onions. I have a meeting in the afternoon, and I tend to sweat if I eat spicy food."

The store instantly became lively.

"Hey, Lao Fan, have you watched those two videos?" Liu Ye suddenly raised his head and shouted towards the kitchen.

Fan Li was holding a colander in his hand to scoop out noodles. When he heard this, he asked in confusion, "What video?"

Liu Ye was overjoyed and said, "Da Fei! It's that store-exploring blogger with a lot of fans. I just found it at noon today."

Xu Feng came over and said, "What did he say?"
